subject: Important Update: Account Security
body: Dear valued customer, In our continuous efforts to enhance security and protect your account, we are implementing a new two-factor authentication process. Starting next week, you will be required to verify your identity using a unique code sent to your registered email or phone number. This additional layer of security will help safeguard your personal information from unauthorized access. Thank you for your cooperation and understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our support team.
